summary: Practise HAZWOPER site assessment, PPE selection and response planning in a five-day foundation course. Explore the course outline.
lede: HAZWOPER training prepares hazardous-waste workers, site supervisors and response teams to make safe field decisions. You practise reading Safety Data Sheets and GHS labels, assessing site hazards, choosing PPE within stated limits, and planning control zones and decontamination steps. Exercises also develop monitoring records, incident handoffs and a site response action plan, with advanced instrument interpretation and incident-coordination concepts covered at foundation level; the course does not confer regulatory certification.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who work around hazardous waste, support site safety or take part in emergency response. It suits you if your role requires you to follow site controls and communicate hazards clearly, while your employer remains responsible for job-specific authorization and procedures.
prerequisites: No prior HAZWOPER qualification is assumed. You should be able to follow written safety instructions and take part in workplace safety briefings.
